info.title: Bloom Health & Wellness API
info.description: Standalone Node.js/TypeScript backend. Frontend integration is intentionally not included. Monetary values use integer satang (fields ending Cents). Bearer access and rotating refresh tokens. Manual bank-transfer proof review is implemented; development payments are opt-in and prohibited in production.
